mechanism.claim: A same-session rise or fall across at least three of VIX, VXN, GVZ, and OVX represents broad repricing of equity, technology, gold, and oil uncertainty rather than an idiosyncratic volatility-index move. In a high-realized-variation BTC regime, broad volatility expansion maps short BTC and broad contraction maps long BTC for the following twelve hours.
mechanism.side: short when at least three completed Cboe close-to-close log changes are positive; long when at least three are negative; a 2-2 split is ineligible
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior Cboe relays used one index, term/convexity ratios, pairwise rotations, or BTC directional confirmation. CAVBR uses cross-asset sign breadth across four underlying risk domains and no prior event set or diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized-variation rank at the next-session decision must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official next-Cboe-session 09:35 ET entries conditioned on four-index breadth are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.common_source_dates: exact intersection of positive finite daily closes for VIX,VXN,GVZ,OVX
features.index_changes: log(current close/previous exact common-source-date close), independently by index
features.breadth: count strictly positive and strictly negative changes; zero contributes to neither side; exactly one count must be at least three
features.availability: a source-date breadth is usable no earlier than 09:30 America/New_York on the next exact common Cboe source date
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over exact BTCUSDT 1m rows in the 24 elapsed hours ending at next-session 09:30 ET
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 previous valid next-session decisions; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.missing_duplicate_nonpositive_or_no_next: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: next exact common Cboe source date 09:30 America/New_York
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent four-domain volatility breadth plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no breadth, clock, threshold, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
